caseStudies.title: Case Studies
caseStudies.subtitle: How I solve real problems and what value it brings.

aiChatbot.title: AI Agent Integration
aiChatbot.problem: The portfolio lacked interactivity. Visitors had to read long text to learn about my experience.
aiChatbot.solution: I built an AI agent with the Claude API that can answer questions, show GitHub projects, and forward messages.
aiChatbot.result: Visitors can now ask questions in natural language and get answers in seconds.

homelab.title: Server Automation
homelab.problem: Manual backups took a lot of time and were often forgotten.
homelab.solution: I built an automated system with Ansible, GitHub Actions, and Google Drive that runs backups every night.
homelab.result: Backups are now done automatically, and I receive notifications on my phone about their status.

performance.title: Performance Optimization
performance.problem: The website took a long time to load, especially on mobile devices.
performance.solution: I optimized Next.js components, added dynamic imports, and fixed image loading.
performance.result: I achieved a score of 100 on Google PageSpeed Insights and 100 on SEO.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Intro: This site is designed to be privacy-first. We do not sell your data.
privacy.chatHistoryText: Stored server-side in a database, linked to an anonymous cookie. If you clear the chat using the button in the chat window, your history is permanently deleted.
privacy.preferencesText: We store a small cookie to remember your Dark/Light mode choice.
privacy.visitorIdText: An anonymous cookie is used to link your chat history to your browser. It contains no personal information.
privacy.section2Text: Our AI assistant extracts and stores durable facts about your interests (e.g., 'interested in Docker') in a separate database table. These facts are used to personalize your experience in future conversations. They are linked to your anonymous Visitor ID and can be deleted at any time by clearing the chat.
privacy.section3Text: We use Anthropic Claude AI to power the chat. Any prompts you send are processed by Anthropic. We also use Voyage AI to generate text embeddings (mathematical vectors) for search. We do not send your personal identity to them.
privacy.section4Text: As an EU resident, you have the right to access or delete your data. You can delete your chat history and long-term memory at any time by clicking the clear button inside the chat window. This permanently removes your data from our servers.
privacy.section5Text: To ensure the security and performance of this site, our server automatically logs standard technical information when you visit. This includes your IP address, browser type, and the pages you access.
privacy.section5LegalText: We process this data based on our Legitimate Interest (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)) to maintain website security, prevent fraud, and allow search engines to crawl and index the site accurately.
privacy.section6Text: Server logs are typically kept for 30 days before being automatically deleted. Your Chat History and Long-Term Memory are stored on our server until you choose to clear them using the chat window. Your Theme Preferences stay on your device until you clear your browser cookies.
